name: Schaumburg Specialties - Racks & Carts
old_description: From industrial bakeries and donut CMLs to airline catering commissaries and prepared meal facilities, SHOPCraft delivers high-performance oven racks, bakery carts, processing tables, and dough troughs that keep your production line running smoothly.
about:
Schaumburg Specialties is based in Schaumburg, Illinois. The company does not publicly state its founding year, ownership type, or founder names.

The company manufactures three primary product lines: SHOPCraft for bakery and food production (oven racks, bakery carts, processing tables, dough troughs), KWIKCraft for high-volume food processing (all-welded speed racks for meat, seafood, prepared meals, pet food), and AGRICraft for agriculture and indoor farming (germination racks and custom solutions). It offers custom metal fabrication, welded construction, design collaboration, and bulk product development. The firm also provides maintenance and equipment servicing. Materials include 18-gauge aluminum and stainless steel, with some products featuring anodized coatings. NSF-certified donut basket racks are available.

Customers span industrial bakeries, donut production lines, airline catering commissaries, prepared meal facilities, meat and seafood processors, pet food manufacturers, and indoor farming operations. Named references include David's Burgers, Bimbo, Illinois State University, Carolina CPL Co-Op, Udi's (Pinnacle Foods), and operations in Appleton, WI; Elk Grove, IL; and Chapel Hill, NC.

Schaumburg Specialties emphasizes American-made, tariff-free production and a lifetime guarantee on its racks and carts. It highlights welded construction for durability and low maintenance, top-of-the-line materials, and designs that improve productivity, safety, and efficiency. The company states its metal fabrication heritage is central to its identity.
built_on: Lifetime guarantee on all racks and carts
type_evidence: Metal fabrication: it's in our DNA. Here at Schaumburg Specialties, when we say our range of custom racks and carts are built to last, we mean it.
